veranderings.voor: sy eie hart was besig om te misluk
veranderings.na: sy eie hart was aan die ingee
veranderings.rede: 'besig om te misluk' calques English 'was failing'; 'aan die ingee' is the idiomatic Afrikaans for an organ giving out.
